Author: MathDad
Name: Senpan Admin Companion
Description: Serves as an alternative to many of the web-interface functions, allowing staff to operate various systems from within the game.
Punchline: Allows Senpan Tea House staff to use various app services right from the game.
Changelog: Tea rooms can be locked from the Tea Rooms page, with an optional unlock time (or quick +30m / +1h / +2h / +4h). When that time arrives the room unlocks itself and you are told in game - a chime, a toast, and a line in your own chat log naming the room.
